title: Analysts’ Recent Ratings Updates for Apple (AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) recently received a number of ratings updates from brokerages and research firms: 6/26/2018 – Apple had its “equal weight” rating reaffirmed by analysts at Barclays PLC. They now have a $190.00 price target on the stock. 6/18/2018 – Apple was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating. 6/13/2018 – Apple was given a new $210.00 price target on by analysts at UBS Group AG. They now have a “buy” rating on the stock. 6/11/2018 – Apple had its “buy” rating reaffirmed by analysts at Macquarie. They noted that the move was a valuation call. 5/23/2018 – Apple was downgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating. 5/9/2018 – Apple was upgraded by analysts at BidaskClub from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating. 5/3/2018 – Apple was upgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating. According to Zacks, “Apple’s second-quarter fiscal 2018 results benefited from growth in iPhone and Services segment. The Services segment on the back of growing Apple Music & Apple Pay has become the new cash cow for the company. The higher ASP of iPhone X is boosting the top-line growth. Demand in China rebounded strongly driven by iPhone, Services, Mac and Watch sales. Going ahead, we believe Apple’s foray into fast-growing technologies like autonomous vehicle, artificial intelligence (AI) & AR/VR will drive growth. Shares have outperformed the industry in the past year. However, Apple faces significant competition in most of its operating markets. The rise of feature-rich regional smartphones at a much cheaper price remains a major headwind.” 5/2/2018 – Apple had its price target raised by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies to $214.00. Shares of NASDAQ AAPL traded up $2.26 during mid-day trading on Tuesday, reaching $184.43. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 24,421,434 shares, compared to its average volume of 33,202,055. The firm has a market cap of $938.29 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 20.02, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.52 and a beta of 1.29. The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $142.28 and a 52 week high of $194.20. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $60.94 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $2.10 earnings per share. research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 EPS for the current fiscal year.
